claims.text: Chronic LBP w inadequate response to nonpharm tx: NSAIDs first-line; tramadol or duloxetine second-line.
claims.quote: In patients with chronic low back pain who have had an inadequate response to nonpharmacologic therapy, clinicians and patients should consider pharmacologic treatment with nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs as first-line therapy, or tramadol or duloxetine as second-line therapy
claims.locator: Qaseem A, et al. Noninvasive Treatments for Acute, Subacute, and Chronic Low Back Pain: A Clinical Practice Guideline From the American College of Physicians. Ann Intern Med 2017;166(7):514-530

claims.text: Duloxetine: labeled for chronic MSK pain in adults.
